scenario: A runaway trolley is speeding down the tracks towards five workmen who will be killed if the trolley continues on its present course. I am standing next to the tracks, but I am too far away to warn them. Next to me there is a control switch that can redirect the trolley onto a different track, where only one workman is working. If I flip the control switch it will divert the trolley onto the track with one workman and will not continue its course towards the five workmen. This will kill this workman, but it will save the other five.
choice: I decide to divert the trolley by flipping the control switch
entities: i,5 workmen on the trolley’s current track,1 workman on the alternate track
outcomes: The trolley goes onto the track with one workman
The five workmen are no longer in the trolley's path
